name: POVO AI Guidance - Nightly Guidance Refresh v1

parameters.content:
## POVO AI Guidance - Nightly Guidance Refresh v1

Runs **05:00 Mon–Fri, America/New_York** (workflow setting `timezone`).

1. `POST {POVO_BACKEND_URL}/api/v1/jobs/refresh-guidance` → `{run_id, territories, snapshot_date}` (timeout 300 s, 3 tries)
2. `POST {POVO_BACKEND_URL}/api/v1/jobs/purge-ai-cache` → `{deleted}` (3 tries)
3. **Summarise Run**: returns a one-line summary; throws (execution marked failed) if either job failed.

Both calls send `X-POVO-Service-Token: $env.POVO_SERVICE_TOKEN`. n8n needs `N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false`.
No email / chat alerting (out of scope): check the executions list.
